name: What is the difference between flat, eggshell, satin, and semi-gloss paint finishes?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between flat, eggshell, satin, and semi-gloss paint finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paint finishes vary in sheen and durability, impacting both appearance and function. Flat paint has no sheen and is ideal for low-traffic areas or to hide imperfections. Eggshell and satin finishes offer a subtle sheen and are more durable, suitable for living rooms and bedrooms. Semi-gloss has a higher sheen and is very durable, perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, and trim due to its ease of cleaning. Understanding these differences is a decision factor for selecting the appropriate finish based on the room's usage and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint finishes range from no-sheen flat to high-sheen semi-gloss, each offering different durability and aesthetic qualities suitable for specific room types.
